title: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the range, var
question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes per course offered by that department (considering only degree-granting courses in Mathematics), and what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in the 2022 academic year (considering only if the department has more than five subjects offered in 2022, is degree-granting, and is not Chemistry)? Show the department name, subject code count range, subject code count variance, subject code count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH math_dept AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
    AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
),
per_course AS (
  SELECT cco.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_code_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cco.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  GROUP BY cco.SUBJECT_ID
),
stats AS (
  SELECT MAX(subj_code_cnt) - MIN(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_range,
         VARIANCE(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_var,
         STDDEV(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_std
  FROM per_course
),
units AS (
  SELECT STDDEV(cco.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_std
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cco2.SUBJECT_CODE) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco2 WHERE cco2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cco2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022') > 5
)
SELECT md.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       s.subj_code_range,
       s.subj_code_var,
       s.subj_code_std,
       u.total_units_std
FROM math_dept md
CROSS JOIN stats s
CROSS JOIN units u

WITH MathDeptStddev AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptStddev2022 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022 FROM MathDeptStddev AS mds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 AS dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` GROUP BY HGN_CODE) AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.num_subjects_offered, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.join_department_name ORDER BY subq1.total_units_variance DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column

WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP), DepartmentSubjects AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_TERM_CODE, subq1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.cip_code_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) WITH math_dept AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
    AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
),
per_course AS (
  SELECT cco.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_code_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cco.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  GROUP BY cco.SUBJECT_ID
),
stats AS (
  SELECT MAX(subj_code_cnt) - MIN(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_range,
         VARIANCE(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_var,
         STDDEV(subj_code_cnt) AS subj_code_std
  FROM per_course
),
units AS (
  SELECT STDDEV(cco.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_std
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cco2.SUBJECT_CODE) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco2 WHERE cco2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cco2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022') > 5
)
SELECT md.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       s.subj_code_range,
       s.subj_code_var,
       s.subj_code_std,
       u.total_units_std
FROM math_dept md
CROSS JOIN stats s
CROSS JOIN units u

),
course_subject_counts AS (

    cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.SUBJECT_ID
),
subject_code_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(subject_code_count) - MIN(subject_code_count) AS subject_code_range,
    VARIANCE(subject_code_count) AS subject_code_variance,
    STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS subject_code_stddev
  FROM course_subject_counts
),
math_2022_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cco.SUBJECT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS subject_count,
    SUM(cco.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  JOIN math_dept md ON cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
),
total_units_stats AS (
  SELECT
    STDDEV(total_units) AS total_units_stddev
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m22.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m22.SUBJECT_CODE, m22.total_units
    FROM math_2022_subjects m22
    WHERE m22.subject_count > 5
  ) t
)

  scs.subject_code_variance,
